data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Khaba' which means 'to perish' or 'to be destroyed'. The name Khabeera signifies a patient, enduring woman who overcomes adversity and remains steadfast in her faith.

in_arabic.name: خابيرا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خابيرا مشتق من الجذر العربي 'خ-ب-ر' والذي يعني العلم والمعرفة. يرمز الاسم إلى الشخصية الحكيمة والعالمة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن العلم والمعرفة.

in_urdu.name: خابیرا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام خابیرا عربی جڑ 'خ-ب-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے علم اور معرفت۔ یہ نام حکیمہ اور علم کی شخصیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اور اسلامی تقلید میں علم اور حکمت کے تناظر میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: खाबीरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम खाबीरा अरबी जड़ 'خ-ب-ر' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है ज्ञान और समझ। यह नाम बुद्धिमान और ज्ञानी व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाता है, और इस्लामी परंपरा में ज्ञान और बुद्धिमत्ता के संदर्भ में इसका उल्लेख किया गया है।

in_pashto.name: خابيره
in_pashto.long_meaning: د خابيره نوم د عربي ريښې 'خ-ب-ر' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د پوهې او معلوماتو معنی لري. دا نوم د هوښيار او پوهندې شخصيت څرګندوي، او په اسلامي دود کې د پوهې او حکمت په تناظر کې يې ذکر شوی دی.

in_english.name: Khabeera
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khabeera originates from the Arabic root 'خ-ب-ر' (khabara), meaning to know or to have knowledge. It signifies a person who is wise, learned, and knowledgeable. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with wisdom, intelligence, and spiritual insight. The root 'خ-ب-ر' is mentioned in the Quran in contexts related to knowledge and awareness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khabeera holds a profound cultural significance as it reflects the resilient spirit of women in the Islamic community. Khabeera is a name given to women who possess the strength and fortitude to endure through challenging times. It is a reflection of the deep-rooted cultural values of perseverance, resilience, and courage, which are highly valued in Islamic society. The name Khabeera is a reminder of the strength and courage that women possess, and a source of inspiration for future generations.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Khabeera holds a deep significance as it represents the spirit of submission and faith in Allah (SWT). The name Khabeera signifies a woman who remains steadfast in her faith, even in the face of adversity. It is a reminder of the strength and patience that comes from a deep connection with Allah (SWT), and the confidence that comes from knowing that Allah (SWT) is always with us. The name Khabeera inspires us to strive for patience, endurance, and faith in Allah (SWT), and to remain steadfast in our spiritual journey, no matter what challenges we may face.
